meta.notes: S-K 1300 2026 Feasibility Study fixture. Table 19-2 pp.296-298 is canonical for the public annual economic axis Y-2,Y-1,Y1..Y10 and annual cash-flow placement. The report explicitly states that detailed closure cash flows extend 20+ years beyond mine life and are not shown in the annual table; Table 19-2 collapses the disclosed US$21.1m closure total into Y10. The detailed timing is therefore not reconstructible from the public report. The report also states cash flows are taken at the midpoint of each period. Runtime calendar placement uses a user-approved 2029 production-start consensus assumption as of 2026-09-06, informed by the current permitting status and the FS 18-month construction duration. It is explicitly not report or company production-year guidance and does not alter the report-relative economic axis or reconciliation.

productionStart.pageOrTable: User-approved consensus runtime assumption informed by Paramount's May 28, 2026 FS release, the September 2, 2026 BLM Plan of Operations approval, and the FS 18-month construction duration; Paramount does not directly guide to a production-start year.
productionStart.notes: Runtime calendar assumption only. This is not technical-report timing evidence and not company production-year guidance. With productionStartPeriod=1 it maps report Y-2/t0 to 2028, Y-1/t1 to 2029 and Y1/t2 to 2030 without stretching or shifting the report-relative arrays.

runtimePlacement.notes: 2029 is an explicit user-approved consensus/working assumption for runtime placement. Report reconciliation ignores runtime placement and remains tied exactly to Table 19-2 Y-2,Y-1,Y1..Y10.

reportLockedItems.label: Sherry and Yates 1.5% gross-proceeds royalty

runtimeProxyRule.label: Sherry and Yates 1.5% gross-proceeds royalty
runtimeProxyRule.notes: The report states a 1.5% royalty of gross proceeds covering the Grassy Mountain deposit. The annual report leg remains the rounded Table 19-2 royalty row.

reportLockedItems.notes: Table 19-2 annual royalties sum to US$21.1m. Seabridge's 10% NPI is deliberately excluded because the FS assumes conversion to Paramount equity once construction financing is secured. Other Project-area royalties do not cover claims hosting current Mineral Resources or Mineral Reserves.

taxModel.notes: REPORT: exact rounded Table 19-2 Corporate Income Tax cash-flow row, totaling US$117.2m. RUNTIME: transparent 28.6% proxy equal to the disclosed 21% US federal rate plus 7.6% Oregon rate, with loss carryforward. The report tax model includes historical expenditures and tax-pool balances that are not published annually, so runtime does not pretend to reconstruct the MNP tax model.

report.npvIrrPageOrTable: Section 19.6 pp.294-296; Table 19-1 pp.295-296; annual cash flow Table 19-2 pp.296-298
report.assumptionsNotes: Real Q2 2026 USD; 100% equity; 18-month construction period; 9.3-year mine life; Au US$3,600/oz; Ag US$48/oz; 5% discount rate; cash flows taken at midpoint of each period and discounted to start of construction; 21% US federal corporate income tax plus 7.6% Oregon tax; 1.5% Sherry and Yates gross-proceeds royalty; Seabridge 10% NPI excluded by the FS conversion assumption. Table 19-2 annual sustaining rows sum to US$64.9m while Table 19-1 reports US$65.1m; annual rows are canonical for annual-table reconciliation. Table 19-2 explicitly says detailed closure cash flows extend 20+ years beyond mine life and are not shown, so the public annual table cannot reproduce exact detailed closure timing.

reportedCostCheckpoints.definitionNotes: Report cash cost net of silver by-product; includes mining, processing, mine-level G&A, refining charges and royalties.
Project-level AISC net of silver by-product; includes cash costs plus sustaining capital and closure costs and excludes corporate G&A.
